title: Trait-space Monitoring for Emergent Misalignment During Supervised Finetuning
abstract: arXiv:2606.07631v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM) occurs when narrow finetuning induces dangerous behavior outside the finetuning task. Detecting this shift through repeated behavioral evaluation is costly, motivating our checkpoint-level monitoring from internal representations. We define a fixed coordinate system from seven alignment-relevant activation directions and use it to track representational drift during LoRA finetuning of four open-source 7-9B language models. Finetuning drift in this space exhibits a dominant axis that explains 78.6% of variance and remains stable across datasets, extraction choices, and parameter-update capacities. Across 468 checkpoints from three EM-relevant held-out datasets, the resulting monitors attain 1.8% FNR, 2.0% FPR, and 0.989 AUROC, outperforming semantic, random, PCA, and SAE feature baselines. translated_title: 监督微调过程中涌现性错位的特质量空间监控
translated_abstract: 涌现性错位（Emergent Misalignment, EM）是指狭窄范围的微调会诱导模型在微调任务之外产生危险行为。通过反复的行为评估来检测这种转变成本高昂，这促使我们基于内部表示开展检查点级别的监控。我们利用七个与对齐相关的激活方向定义了一个固定坐标系，并用它来跟踪四个开源7-9B语言模型在LoRA微调过程中的表示漂移。该空间中的微调漂移呈现出一个主导轴，可解释78.6%的方差，且在不同数据集、特征提取方式和参数更新容量下保持稳定。在来自三个与EM相关的保留数据集的468个检查点上，所得监控器实现了1.8%的漏报率（FNR）、2.0%的误报率（FPR）和0.989的AUROC，优于语义、随机、PCA和SAE特征等基线方法。在第四个数据集上，匹配的良性-危险对照实验表明，大幅度的表示漂移也可能……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出基于七个对齐相关激活方向构建的固定特质量空间坐标系，通过监控LoRA微调过程中的表示漂移，以0.989的AUROC和极低的误报/漏报率高效检测涌现性错位，无需昂贵的行为评估。
en_tdlr: A fixed trait-space coordinate system built from seven alignment-relevant activation directions enables cheap and accurate detection of emergent misalignment during LoRA finetuning, achieving 0.989 AUROC with low FPR/FNR without costly behavioral evaluations.
